object.attr: derived: the target changed after the review, so the review doesn't cover it. The full hash, so that a prefix naming two commits can't pass (requirements review Q20). Open question Q6. Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If the commit given with a link key isn't the full hash of the target's last change, the MCP server's ack_suspects tool shall refuse to acknowledge that link.
